top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Listing (26 TAC §742.403(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not verified liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two Epi Pens were located in the child's backpack. One backpack was in the hall accessible to children. One backpack was hanging on a hook in a classroom accessible to children.  This was corrected at inspection when the Epi-Pens were removed from the backpacks and placed in a cabinet where is was inaccessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire extinguisher in the vehicle used for transportation has not been serviced. Fire extinguisher is empty at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the walk through a trash can with food waste was observed in reach of children and accessible.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was yelling at children.
